title: InterpretResponse
description: Validated response returned by the Companion Service containing structured proposals and clarification requests. Never contains executable code, selectors, or insertion authority.

requestId.description: Matches the requestId of the initiating InterpretRequest.

formInstanceId.description: Identifier of the target form snapshot.

proposedUpdates.description: Proposed field value updates derived from the transcript. Field IDs must correspond strictly to validated fields from the request.

fieldId.description: Opaque field ID from the request. Selectors, scripts, and unknown IDs are rejected.

value.description: Proposed value. For checkboxes, this must be a boolean. For select/radio, this must be an exact match to an allowed option value.

confidence.description: Estimated confidence of the model extraction between 0.0 and 1.0.

reasoning.description: Brief human-readable rationale for the proposed assignment. Must not contain executable code or script tags.

clarifications.description: Questions synthesized when user input is ambiguous or requires user choice among discrete options.

question.description: Natural language question to be synthesized by Piper TTS and presented in the UI.

targetFieldIds.description: Opaque field IDs to which this clarification pertains.

suggestedOptions.description: Optional list of discrete options to present to the user.

unmatchedFacts.description: User-supplied facts detected in the transcript that could not be mapped to any discovered field.
